description: Get NRW telemetry measures and latest observations for a station_id. Preserves reported units and quality codes (OGL v3). Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.

station_id.description: Station identifier returned by the corresponding provider's station discovery tool.

name: nrw_measures
